card.name: Gradual before taper in withdrawal warnings
card.fires_on: The word "gradual" or "gradually" right before "taper" in warnings about stopping a drug, usually a benzodiazepine or opioid. It appears after "To reduce the risk of withdrawal reactions, use a".

modes.label: use a gradual taper
modes.description: "gradual" after "use a" in the withdrawal-reaction warning, ahead of "taper to discontinue".
modes.example: To reduce the risk of withdrawal reactions, use a<< gradual>> taper to discontinue flurazepam

modes.label: gradually taper
modes.description: The adverb "gradually" before the verb "taper" when discontinuing a tablet.
modes.example: When discontinuing Pentazocine and Naloxone Tablets,<< gradually>> taper the dosage (see DOSAGE AND

card.writes: It pushes toward words about a smooth, stepwise way of completing a process, such as "way" and "completion".
card.plain: It lights up on "gradual" in the instruction to slowly taper a drug rather than stop it suddenly.
